name: Cheesy Portobello "Smash" Burger with Avocado, Sprouts & Romaine Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, ketchup, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp ketchup
¾ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
6 tomatoes
3 avocados
1 ½ (3 oz) pkgs alfalfa sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Remove stems from portobello mushrooms. Place on a large plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add mushrooms, cap-side down. Cook until starting to soften, about 3 minutes. Flip and continue to cook, occasionally pressing down with the bottom of a spatula, until golden underneath, 2-3 minutes more.
While the mushrooms are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are golden underneath, flip once more and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and mushrooms are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Slice three tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds; medium dice remaining tomatoes. Place slices on a clean large plate and add diced tomato to the bowl with the lettuce and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice lengthwise into thin slices. Add to the plate with the tomato.

Spread special sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with cheesy portobellos, then layer with tomato, avocado, and sprouts. Close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
